notes.text:
Missing it-kārya for the nuṭ Augment (Engine Defect)
Step: [PED] Header block & #63
Sūtras involved: 7.1.54 ह्रस्वनद्यापो नुट्, 1.3.3 हलन्त्यम्, 1.3.2 उपदेशेऽजनुनासिक इत्, 1.3.9 तस्य लोपः.
Issue: As the [PED] warning box explicitly flags ("⚠ Am → nAm — the engine put this in without running 1.3.2–1.3.9 on it"), the engine directly replaced Am with nAm in step #63.
This is a severe violation of Engine Principles #1 and #4. 7.1.54 prescribes the augment nuṭ, not the bare consonant 'n'.
The 'ṭ' is an it-letter (deleted by 1.3.3) that crucially tells Pāṇini to attach the augment to the beginning of the suffix (1.1.46 आद्यन्तौ टकितौ).
The 'u' is an it-letter (deleted by 1.3.2) added for ease of pronunciation.
The engine hardcoded the result 'n' and glued it to 'ām', entirely skipping the it-engine that gives nuṭ its grammatical meaning.

Classification: Engine defect (Major).
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-16 — Repeat of a stamped note; resolved, see S174 (nuṭ shown as a bare n, no it-steps; 7.1.54 is named there). S183 spike: needs one design for ādeśa/āgama Terms with it-steps (coordinator). No new work.
